method: The listed brown rice quantity is the dry, uncooked weight. Follow the cooking and assembly steps below for this measured portion.
The listed brown rice is a dry weight. Cook it in a saucepan using the water quantity and cooking time on its packet, until tender; drain if needed.
Wash and dice the mixed peppers. Use ready-to-eat canned sweetcorn, drained before weighing; keep both ready for assembly.
Use chilled, already-cooked chicken breast; slice it thinly or shred it into small pieces. Keep it refrigerated until assembly.
Use the measured tomato pepper relish as a ready-to-eat sauce or dressing; stir in all the measured olive oil. Keep chilled sauces refrigerated until assembly.

For immediate serving, put the hot cooked rice in a bowl, add the peppers, sweetcorn and chilled ready-to-eat filling, then fold through the measured tomato pepper relish and olive oil dressing. Eat immediately.

For a cold packed lunch, spread the rice in a shallow container and chill quickly, ideally within one hour, before combining it with the chilled filling. Refrigerate the finished meal and eat within 24 hours, following any shorter ingredient use-by date. Keep it chilled until eating.
